problem_statement: Let f0(z) = |z + 1|^{1/2} g_{-1,1/4}(z) on the unit circle, the Fisher-Hartwig symbol with alpha = 1/4, beta = 1/4 at z0 = -1 and V = 0, and let w(z) = z f0(z), which has winding number kappa = 1. Let D_n(w) be its n-by-n Toeplitz determinant. Determine the large-n asymptotic of D_n(w), identifying the winding-induced power law, the alternating sign, and the explicit nonzero winding factor relating D_n(w) to the zero-winding base determinant D_n(f0).
